title: Geneva Protocol on gas and bacteriological warfare
summary: The Protocol, signed at Geneva on 17 June 1925 at the close of a League of Nations conference that began on 4 May, prohibits the use in war of asphyxiating, poisonous or other gases and of bacteriological methods of warfare. It entered into force on 8 February 1928.

uncertainty.note: Signed 17 June 1925; entered into force 8 February 1928. The conference ran 4 May to 17 June 1925.
